corrections.was: A drawing that builds one sentence from a mechanic. The Hook is the most distinctive thing the player does, said in one sentence. It names what you do and what that changes. Here, reverse gravity, so hazards become pathways, in eight words. A tagline is memorable words, and a hook is the one thing nobody else has. For example, if the player in your game can freeze an enemy and stand on it, the hook is, freeze an enemy to make your next step.
